title: Pall Mall — past the clubs (linear cut)
learning_goal: Linear-cut stand-in for the Street View walk: know the 1,151 steps and see the three clubs in a row — as one hyperlapse and three façades, not as a continuous walk.

narration.script: From Savile Row, Fogg walks to his club and counts. Five hundred and seventy-five steps with the right foot, five hundred and seventy-six with the left. One thousand one hundred and fifty-one. He never hurries. We are on Pall Mall now, walking west through clubland. It was one of the first streets in London lit by gas, in 1807. Watch the left side: the Athenaeum at 107, then the Travellers at 106. Then the palazzo with the tall windows — the Reform Club, 104 Pall Mall, by Charles Barry, opened 1841. Fogg made it 1,151 steps. We make it about a kilometre.

variants.clear: From Savile Row, Fogg walks to his club and counts his steps. One thousand one hundred and fifty-one steps. He never hurries. We are now on Pall Mall, walking west. This is clubland — a street of private clubs. It was one of the first streets in London with gas lamps, in 1807. Watch the left side: the Athenaeum at No. 107, then the Travellers at No. 106. Then the grand building with tall windows: the Reform Club, No. 104, by Charles Barry, opened 1841. Fogg counted 1,151 steps. We measure about one kilometre.

production_notes: LINEAR CUT ONLY. Replaces 04 count-the-steps in the passive version. A8 2026-08-19 (content-preparer): RE-CUT 76 s → 42 s. The old shape needed a 76-second continuous westbound façade pass past 107 / 106 / 104 Pall Mall; manifest-a6.md established that no such shot exists at ladder rungs 1–3, and rights-a6.md §3.6 approved the re-shape rather than a licence. New shape (A6's proposal, tightened): 8 s M-67 hyperlapse → 8 s M-69a Athenaeum → 8 s M-69b Travellers → 10 s M-20 Reform façade → 8 s M-22 Barry elevation. The WORDS ARE UNCHANGED (102 standard / 94 clear); only the seconds moved, 102/42 = 2.43 w/s and 94/42 = 2.24 w/s, both inside the 2.5 w/s budget. Overlays re-timed to the shorter scene (caption 4–12, gloss 16–24, Travellers 18–26, Reform 28–40) and kept at three timed overlays, the ceiling for 42 s. 'Watch the left side' still holds: M-67 is westbound and the clubs are on the south (left) side. M-01 stays as the PLAYER source (`use: player`); it is Standard YouTube Licence, so it may be embedded and may not be copied.

A1 narrator 2026-08-18: 30- and 32-word sentences split; 'watch the left side' kept (west-bound); 99 words / 76 s. A3n narrator+scene-developer 2026-08-19 (newcomer rewrite): 'walks to his club' names the destination for a first-time viewer (linear cut has no scene 04); clubland gloss chip; clear-English variant added. A8 2026-08-19 (content-preparer): scene re-cut 76 → 42 s (the redesign rights-a6.md §3.6 asked for, not a licence). Media added: M-67 (KartaView hyperlapse, CC BY-SA 4.0, `sa: true`), M-69a/M-69b (geograph façades), M-20, M-22 — all `use: linear`; M-01 marked `use: player`. Honest limits: M-67 is a 2016 road-centre dashcam at ~25 m spacing, so the clubs pass obliquely at the frame edge and the moving shot cannot itself identify 104/106/107 — the stills and the narration do that. Frame idx 831 was downloaded and viewed (Royal Automobile Club front, blue flag, twin lanterns) which confirms the sequence is Pall Mall clubland, but WHICH frame shows the Reform is unpinned.
